articles.summary: Community First Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: CFBI) (“CFBI”), the parent company of Newton Federal Bank, and ABB Financial Group, Inc. (“ABB”), parent company of Affinity Bank, announced today that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement whereby CFBI has agreed to acquire ABB and its wholly owned bank subsidiary, Affinity Bank, in an all-cash transaction. articles.title: Community First Bancshares, Inc. Executes Merger Agreement to Acquire ABB Financial Group, Inc.
